meta.title: A closed RFQ: the "Responses" tab opens

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Responses screen.
Activate the Responses tab as described by the case.
Verify the Responses tab opened and the response route is ready.
Confirm representative Responses content is visible.

args.text: Use < or > to navigate the event with your keyboard

steps.note: Confirm the Responses screen content rendered as expected.
Verify that opening the Responses tab produced no application error.
